specs.title: API auth, cookie contract and logout revoke access
catalog controls money and malformed orders never create state
order ownership is private and idempotency keys belong to users
concurrent equivalent checkout replays once and persists across restart
payment signatures, exact raw bytes and mismatched values reject without side effects
concurrent payment redelivery, conflict and distinct event IDs fulfill once durably
transient fulfillment rolls back receipt then same event succeeds after restart
browser checkout restores order on reload and reflects server payment
actual reset email completes browser flow and revokes all sessions
reset requests resist account enumeration and tokens expire on the server clock
creates trimmed nonblank titles in order and clears the entry field
duplicate titles remain independent through complete edit and delete
individual completion and restoration keep the active count global under filters

specs.title: saved edits completion order and removals persist through reload and further keyboard input
logout revokes a previously valid copied session on the server
each SKU has its contracted unit price and quantity ten is accepted
correctly signed noncanonical JSON is accepted and identical bytes replay once
single delete persists immediately with survivor order and completion intact
clear completed persists immediately and preserves active titles and order
clearing the final completed item persists the empty state immediately
